traps.why: Cold Br₂/CHCl₃ stops after one bromine. Bromine water brominates every open ortho and para position.

explanation: Phenol is so activated that bromine water brominates every open ortho and para position. Nothing already on the ring is replaced.
tip: Br₂/H₂O: all open o/p spots. Br₂/CHCl₃ cold: just one.

traps.why: Cold Br₂/CHCl₃ stops after one bromine. Bromine water brominates every open ortho and para position.
The group already on the ring does not leave. EAS only replaces ring hydrogens: count the open ortho/para positions.
